acceptance_scope: Finite offline support of the changed source qualification/import/reader and ordinary-retained routing, with the explicitly reproduced storage exclusion. Not universal UNKNOWN quarantine, real-source compatibility, actual SQLite migration or customer-flow acceptance.

qualification: App-owned finite registry pins qualified capsule/closure; selected folders cannot appoint their own pins.
Validator compares closed original raw graph, authority/intent/handoff/admission/observation/release, per-response actual200 and original page identity.

Source database interface uses immutable read-only/query_only SELECT and requires unique actual COMPLETE official-original/page rows and bound output blobs; no actual SQL or Store was run by the reviewers.
atomic_and_reader: Same-book lock precedes import attempt/staging; exact old-state checks and same transaction couple the two official rows with import receipt completion.
Normal publication follows successful transaction exit; tagged official outputs use Store.get closure checks across receipt, rows, marker, coupled original/page and retained raw graph.
The finite fake reader used no reentrant book lock or Store.get recursion. Missing coupled proof refuses consumption. This is not a native SQLite/crash/OS-lock guarantee.
ordinary_and_retained_route: Ordinary customer book/catalog/leaf-directory/page selection calls normal acquire and prepare_section without per-lesson registry/root pin/signature/technical JSON input.
Separately qualified retained migration uses the app-owned facade; retained task mode and source reference persist from earliest save and continue with OCR0/additional-pages0.

An explicit normal PLATFORM choice can continue a WAITING_SOURCE/PREPARING retained task for genuinely unrun source; source failure/UNKNOWN/COMPLETE provenance guards remain, without a global ban on all new pages.

UI checks current generation after import service return and again in the used callback, including receipt book identity before applying the retained catalog. A valid A cache already published is retained when a later UI B context causes HOLD, not rolled back.

validation.case1: Duplicate actual identical COMPLETE rows: first attempt assertions passed and advanced to case2; original aggregate serialization was not reached. Not rerun.
validation.case2: First attempt had helper NameError due missing extracted pure _origin before the target401 check. Only the incomplete case2 was run after that helper correction and passed at the per-response401 gate.

route.method: Exact frozen AST callbacks/functions with inert memory and fake-widget spies; no real GUI or product module import.

control_accounting.author_history: Author route run01 nine passes then run02 repeated nine already-passed methods. Preserve the original history; those repeats are not new coverage and were not rerun independently.

explicit_storage_exclusion.counterexample: replace makes published.json visible and then reports an outcome-unknown exception, while both failure.json persistence and DB UNKNOWN latch persistence are unavailable. Caller gets HOLD, yet the valid published marker plus COMPLETE row can remain readable as closed through Store.get.
explicit_storage_exclusion.author_disclosure: Failure records are best-effort dual stop markers; no guarantee that new failure evidence persists when all relevant storage paths are unwritable.
explicit_storage_exclusion.allowed_claim: With a writable failure latch in the tested finite fault boundary, consumption was refused; missing closure proof fails closed.
explicit_storage_exclusion.forbidden_overclaim: Do not claim every UNKNOWN or publication exception reliably persists quarantine or always prevents future consumption.
explicit_storage_exclusion.actual_machine_occurrence: NOT_OBSERVED; synthetic compound after-effect/storage failure only

minimum_next: Root may accept only this frozen offline support layer. Actual migration requires a genuinely successful qualified capsule and validated adapter/registry entry plus an exact separate real-workspace scope. Ordinary in-app capture must keep its direct path without per-lesson registry/root/technical-JSON dependence. Native GUI/SQL/crash/lock and customer outcomes remain unaccepted; no actual is dispatched here.
